text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as part of my Trainer duties and learning experience, I was allowed to observe a horse girl photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oho... Both of you have finished your makeup, I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! They made us look so wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Especially this blush! The makeup artist said this shade brings out a neat, translucent glow. Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it looks great on you! I really love this lip gloss too. My heart's bouncing with excitement for the shoot!

text_block_list.name: Makeup Artist
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad you both like it. Now then, Air Groove-san, would you step over here next?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood, thank you. ...However, there is one thing I would like to consult you on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Would it be possible to use my own personal eyeshadow for the eye makeup?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I apologize for meddling with a professional's work... but I would be deeply grateful if you could consider it.

text_block_list.name: Makeup Artist
text_block_list.text: Oh... Understood. Then let's design a makeup look that makes that eyeshadow stand out!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have my gratitude. ...I shall make certain this results in the finest photograph possible.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Nothing, just thinking how lovely it is. That dignified makeup suits you perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think so too. That eyeshadow really is what suits you best after all!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, you made a special request to the makeup artist, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It caused some extra trouble, but this was the one thing I could not compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you've been wearing that same eyeshadow since you first enrolled, haven't you? Even when everyone was staring, you wore it with such poise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Both the shade and the application are identical to my mother's.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My mother was a magnificent horse girl. A true "Queen" whose presence captivated everyone who watched... I have reviewed her races countless times.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What left the strongest impression on me was her eyeshadow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even while fiercely locking horns with formidable rivals and giving her all, her eyes remained cloaked in regal elegance. ...I have long admired that beauty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Aha, you've got good taste! This eyeshadow happens to be my favorite too—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "I want every single horse girl out there to have their eyes glued to me♪"

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "G-Glued to you...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Yup! I want my races to captivate everyone completely. So much that they'll never be able to forget me!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "That's why I chose this eyeshadow, you see? It makes me shine the brightest... No one will be able to look away!"

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...! Incredible... To think there was such profound thought behind your makeup...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Um, Mother. If it's alright with you... Would you teach me how to do my makeup someday?"

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "So that just like you, the 'Queen,' I can become an 'Empress' whose image is forever etched into everyone's hearts...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Yes, of course. Hehe, looks like I have another wonderful thing to look forward to in the future♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe... What a wonderful mother. It feels just like a treasured gift passed down to her daughter!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph, quite so. ...This philosophy behind my makeup is something my mother bestowed upon me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. To ensure my image is deeply etched into the minds of my juniors... I will not permit a single compromise in this photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: —H-Hey! Does anyone have that magazine issue featuring Air Groove-senpai?! It's completely sold out everywhere~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A few days later, the photos of Air Groove instantly became the talk of the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. ...It is the eyeshadow I have treasured all this time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're right. You've always worn that eyeshadow... It carries so many memories, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If we're taking a photo together, that's the Air Groove-san I want by my side♪

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I completely agree! You definitely wouldn't be you without that color!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Fool. Do not speak so casually; this feeling of gratitude is by no means a light matter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I am to express it... it will be at the moment I have fulfilled my ideal.
